title: BURNING MACHINES
why: His order of 2026-10-12 on the graphics program: add all of it, item 4, visible damage, the second half after the armour plates. You can now read a hurt machine from across the room. Under half health it throws short bursts of sparks. Under a quarter it is on fire: flames lick over its body and a column of dark smoke climbs off it and drifts, so a machine one burst from dying is the one burning. Your teammate sees the same. Reduced effects halves the smoke. Drawn only: health, damage and every number in the fight are exactly as before.
now: Hurt machines spark under half health and burn with a smoke column under a quarter.
